name: Might Experience Heirloom Cache gives the Burnished chest and shoulder (#8970)
contract: Item 1339056 'Might Experience Heirloom Cache' gave the two set pieces its own description does not list: Polished Breastplate of Might (1548685) and Polished Spaulders of Might (1542949), neither of which carries the set's +10% experience equip spell. Its full cache (1339070) holds the matching Burnished Breastplate of Might (3148685) and Burnished Spaulders of Might (3142949), as every other Experience/full cache pair in the set already matches. The fix updates cache 1339056's two wrong member rows to the Burnished pair; the weapon token and trinket counts are unchanged.

steps.label: Refill a slot freed by a filler item that vanished
SETUP: at least seven slots are free
DISCRIMINATING: the Burnished Breastplate of Might is handed out
DISCRIMINATING: the Burnished Spaulders of Might are handed out
DISCRIMINATING: no Polished Breastplate of Might (lacks the XP bonus)
DISCRIMINATING: no Polished Spaulders of Might (lacks the XP bonus)
